Windows 11, version 26H2 known issues and notifications
Summarize this article for me
Find information on known issues and the status of the Windows 11, version 26H2 availability. For immediate help with Windows update issues, open the Get Help app if you are using a Windows device, or go to support.microsoft.com . Follow @WindowsUpdate on X for Windows release health updates. If you are an IT administrator and want to programmatically get information from this page, use the Windows Updates API in Microsoft Graph .
Current status as of September 29, 2026
Windows 11, version 26H2 has reached general availability. This new version contains all the recently announced features in Windows 11, versions 25H2 and 24H2 and will be delivered using servicing technology, providing a fast installation experience.
The rollout is phased and will expand over the next few months. Starting today, version 26H2 is available on eligible Windows 11, version 25H2 and version 24H2 devices for users who have turned on the setting Get the latest updates as soon as they’re available . If the update is ready for your device, it will download and install automatically, and a single restart will complete the process.
For more details on how to install Windows 11, version 26H2, watch this video .
How to get the Windows 11 2026 Update
An IT pro’s guide to Windows 11, version 26H2

Saturday, 17 October and Sunday, 18 October 2026
Weekend delivery and collection services are expected to take place on Saturday, 17 October and parcel deliveries on Sunday, 18 October.
Most of our Customer Service Points are open over the weekend for you to collect items for which we’ve left a 'Something for you’ card - please visit: royalmail.com/locations .
We aim to deliver to all addresses we have mail for, six days a week. In a small number of local offices, this may temporarily not be possible due to local issues such as high levels of sick absence, resourcing, or other local factors. In those cases, we will rotate deliveries to minimise the delay to individual customers. We also provide targeted support to those offices to address their challenges and restore our service to the high standard our customers would normally receive.
We're sorry for any inconvenience and thank you for your understanding. We will regularly update customers on the offices most impacted here:

If you need to collect an item for which we've left a 'Something for you' card, please check royalmail.com/locations for details of our Customer Service Point locations and opening hours.
During periods of adverse weather, such as extreme heat, or severe wintry conditions, the weather can change quickly, and we continually monitor the conditions and undertake risk assessments to ensure we’re doing all we can to maintain our services, while protecting the safety of our posties - which is our priority.
We may occasionally be unable to safely access certain streets or addresses. When this happens, we may need to temporarily adjust or pause services in the affected areas.
Please be assured, we will do everything we can to maintain and restore our services when it’s safe to do so.
Public and local holidays
We deliver and collect your mail on most days of the year, including Saturdays. However, we don’t usually deliver or collect on public or local holidays. ( Please note: Local holidays are subject to change).

how are you doing recently vs how are you doing lately
Both phrases are correct and commonly used to inquire about someone's well-being. They are interchangeable and can be used in informal conversations to ask about the person's current state or situation.
Last updated: March 25, 2024 • 55598 views
This phrase is correct and commonly used to ask about someone's well-being in informal conversations.
"how are you doing recently"
This phrase is used to inquire about someone's current state or situation in a casual manner. It implies a recent time frame for the inquiry.
